verdict: Yes. Soil Sens from Pune pitched soil intelligence tools on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Farmers who test soil use fertiliser better and save money, but most never test because labs are far and slow.
angle: Soil health cards exist, but testing is slow and infrequent. Quick, portable soil tests with advice in local languages help farmers cut fertiliser costs. FPOs, agri-input dealers and state agriculture departments are key partners.
